extension.description: Turns your Copilot Chat tokens into Pokémon TCG booster packs whose cards level up and evolve, with your monthly quota % in the status bar.
config.quota.monthlyLimit: Assigned monthly quota (in the chosen unit).
config.quota.resetDay: Day of the month (UTC) on which the quota resets.
config.packs.everyTokens: Every how many tokens used you earn a card pack.
config.growth.multiplier: Multiplies the tokens each card needs to evolve.
config.storageRoots: VS Code 'User' folders to read (by default the User folder of Code, Code - Insiders and VSCodium for your operating system).
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (Spanish if it is Spanish, English otherwise).
config.updates.check: Check GitHub once a day for a newer TokenBinder release and offer to install it (never installs without asking). Turn off to stop these requests.
config.mishaps.enabled: Turn on the mishaps of going over your monthly quota: Team Rocket steals a spare card (60%, win it back in a battle), you trip and drop spare copies (30%), or the rain soaks some cards (10%; sleeves and slabs keep cards dry, a Charmandryer saves a soaked one). Cards you invested in are never lost. Off by default; it needs your own monthly limit set, and the first quota period after turning it on is free.
config.online.enabled: Turn on the online leagues: duels against friends and a shared ranking. Off by default. Turning it on asks first and then signs you in with your GitHub account in VS Code; the server only receives your GitHub login, your battle card, roughly how much of your quota you have used and your duel results.
config.online.server: Address of the league server (for example `https://your-league.vercel.app`).
